newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says supports BOJ maintaining monetary policy.
newsitem.headline: MOF says supports BOJ maintaining monetary policy.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Tuesday he supports the view expressed by the Bank of Japan (BOJ) governor that the central bank will maintain its current monetary policy.
Mitsuzuka told a news conference that Japan's economy is firmly recovering, led by domestic demand.
"We will continue to support the overall judgment expressed by Governor (Yasuo) Matsushita that the BOJ will not change its current monetary policy," he said.

Asked if fiscal reform planned by the government would disturb Japan's economy, Mitsuzuka said Japan's economic recovery is firmly in place and structural reforms and "Big Bang" financial reforms should support the economy.
